added: packages/web-contracts (@sos-2/web-contracts): the product web console view-model contracts — pure types + pure projection functions (MissionHero, SystemCondition, ShortfallOpportunity, NextAllowedAction, CurrentChangeSummary, EvidenceQualitySummary, ExperimentStatusSummary, PackageReuseSummary, RecentLearning, ActiveTaskSummary, BodyLeaseSummary, ObservationStatus, the state-block model loading/empty/unknown/unavailable/partial/error, navigation + authority-mode view states, the six product review questions with the rationale view projection, and the gating rule for next allowed actions). Every consequential view model carries what, why (a rationale chain of typed spine trace links), evidence refs, uncertainty, authority and next allowed action, plus an explicit DEMO-vs-LIVE data-source marker whose DEMO label is validated to be exactly 'DEMO — SIMULATED DATA' (a projection that drops the marker fails its test). Zero domain logic, zero DOM: vocabularies (truth states, trace types, phases, permissions, uncertainty classes, maturity) are imported from the owning @sos-2/* packages — never redefined; the rationale chain type is consumed from @sos-2/ui-contracts. The DEMO dataset is built exclusively through the domain packages' own builders (mission store revision, system-state store supersede, evidence creation with all six truth states, candidate + experiment + fixed-seed simulated run, the decision engine + ASK composition + AskQueue, package artifacts, typed trace links) with static literal timestamps (no Date.now, no Math.random) and is revision-pinned to the base head; active tasks, body leases and observation records are clearly-labelled VIEW-LEVEL fixtures with plain ids that reference real spine ids, because their durable runtime contracts belong to P6/P7/P12 and are not frozen yet

apps/web (@sos-2/web): the production Next.js web console shell — ShareNet-inspired interaction hierarchy (desktop left rail: Overview, Mission, System, Changes, Evidence, Experiments, Packages, History, More + persistent status strip with system condition, active experiment, authority mode; mobile compact header + bottom navigation: Overview, Changes, Evidence, ASK, More with 44px touch targets and safe-area padding; native disclosure sheets for deep artifact details). The dominant Overview hero (mission outcome health, current system condition, current shortfall/opportunity, NEXT ALLOWED ACTION with honest gating), the below-hero cards (current change, evidence quality per distinct truth state, experiment status with the simulated run honestly marked, package reuse, recent learning), and the active autonomous work surface (tasks with cloud/local and body-interruption states, ephemeral body leases, observation status with 'SOS is watching' rendered separately from 'a body is working'). First-class named state blocks for loading/empty/unknown/unavailable/partial/error (a page never shows a blank hole); restrained semantic status colors with a separate dashed epistemic treatment for uncertainty, never color-only (every chip carries a glyph and a label); rationale deep-links (/rationale/<kind>/<segment>) answering the six product review questions; skip link, semantic landmarks, aria-current navigation, sr-only context and keyboard-operable disclosures; sticky footer that pushes down with content and respects safe areas. Fully server-rendered (zero client components; the active navigation state is passed per page) from the @sos-2/web-contracts view models over the DEMO fixtures; no next/font, no images, no runtime fetch, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pinned in the scripts
preserved_invariants: the frozen W0-W18 core is untouched: spec/, docs/, scripts/, .github/, pnpm-workspace.yaml and every existing packages/* and apps/* source are unmodified; all P1 changes are additive under the two owned paths plus the declared new-app/new-package skeletons

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: web-contracts and the shell import ids, envelopes, trace links, truth states, phases, permissions, uncertainty classes and maturity vocabulary from the owning workspace packages; no second semantic registry, no invented core identifiers — tasks, body leases and observation records are view-level fixtures with plain (non-spine) ids precisely because no frozen artifact kind exists for them yet (P6/P7/P12 own those contracts)

the 6 evidence truth states remain semantically distinct everywhere: evidence groups render all six with distinct labels, the state-block kinds UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/PARTIAL never conflate, UNAVAILABLE sources stay explicitly unavailable, and the simulated experiment run is marked simulated (evaluation infrastructure, never intervention evidence)

demo fixture state can never render as live state: every fixture-backed view model carries data_source { kind: 'DEMO', label: 'DEMO — SIMULATED DATA', fixture_revision } — the marker is validated by the projection validators and pinned by tests; the demo dataset is static, revision-pinned and deterministic (no Date.now, no Math.random, fixed-seed simulation)

no duplicated SOS domain semantics: the shell contains zero domain logic — every projection comes from @sos-2/web-contracts, which itself only imports domain vocabularies; the rationale chain machinery is consumed from @sos-2/ui-contracts rather than reimplemented

execution actions on demo surfaces are never presented as executable: gateNextAction maps EXECUTE actions on DEMO-backed surfaces to NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_DEMO with the authority requirement shown (the live execution fabric is wired by P9/P12); pending ASK questions outrank autonomous next steps in the hero

Spirit/Body/Observation honesty (journeys 13-17): 'SOS is watching' is a state separate from 'a body is working'; body leases are presented as ephemeral, interchangeable resources with task state, checkpoints and evidence surviving replacement; cloud work is marked as independent of the user's device; local tasks are marked as queued while the device is offline

determinism: no network at build or test time (no next/font, no remote images, no runtime fetch in render paths), NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pinned in the app scripts, next build passes offline, and the full verification suite (verify-repo, verify-productization, pnpm -r build, pnpm -r test) was run twice with identical results
boundary_changes: new-app skeleton at apps/web root (the P1 work order's structurally-required files, nothing else): apps/web/package.json (Next.js 16.3.5 + react/react-dom 19.3.0 + Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 via @tailwindcss/postcss + @sos-2/web-contracts and @sos-2/ui-contracts workspace deps; vitest/typescript/@types devDependencies matching the existing toolchain), apps/web/next.config.ts, apps/web/tsconfig.json, apps/web/.gitignore, apps/web/postcss.config.mjs (Tailwind 4 PostCSS plugin registration — the standard minimal skeleton file for a Tailwind-4 Next app)

thin App Router route wrappers under apps/web/app/** (root layout + one file per shell route + the /rationale/[kind]/[segment] deep-link): each imports only from apps/web/shell or @sos-2/web-contracts and contains no substantive logic (the rationale wrapper awaits the async params and forwards them)

packages/web-contracts package skeleton: packages/web-contracts/package.json and packages/web-contracts/tsconfig.json so core/ is a workspace package (exports resolve to dist/ built from core/src via core/tsconfig.build.json; tests and the vitest config live under core/ inside the owned path)

pnpm-lock.yaml updated by a normal `pnpm install` from the repo root, adding only apps/web's declared dependencies (next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss and their transitive ranges); no other package's dependency semantics changed
no changes to pnpm-workspace.yaml (apps/* and packages/* already cover the new paths), no changes to any frozen path, script, workflow or spec file
